usageNotes: Returns all cluster-wide replication jobs the calling user has VM.Audit permission to see; jobs for VMs the caller cannot audit are silently omitted, so an empty result does not necessarily mean no jobs exist. Each job ID follows the pattern '<VMID>-<JOBNUM>' (e.g. '100-0') and links to a specific target node. Use this as a starting point before creating, modifying, or troubleshooting replication schedules — it requires no parameters and is safe to call at any time.

examples.summary: List all replication jobs visible to the current user

tips: Jobs with 'remove_job' set ('local' or 'full') are already marked for deletion — they will disappear after their next scheduled run completes cleanup.
The 'source' field is populated internally to detect VM migrations (guest stolen from another node); it is not user-settable.
The default schedule '*/15' means every 15 minutes; check the 'schedule' field to understand replication frequency before making bandwidth assumptions.
A job with 'disable: true' will not run but still appears in this list — filter client-side if you only want active jobs.
Rate is expressed in megabytes per second (not megabits); a value of 10 means 10 MB/s.
